lines.text: Joseph has his steward put each man's silver in his sack and the silver cup in the youngest's sack.
At daybreak the brothers leave, and Joseph sends his steward after them to accuse them of repaying good with evil.
The steward searches the sacks from the oldest to the youngest and finds the cup in Reuben's sack.
Jacob said that if they took his other son and harm came to him, he would go down to Sheol in sorrow.
Judah says he guaranteed the boy's safety to Laban, and he asks Joseph to keep him as a slave instead.
